description:
You are one of several procurement officers at a hospital network choosing a vendor for a new patient-records system. Each officer has reviewed different parts of the bids and reference checks.

The options are:
- Vendor A (Ozvoktal Ithbretal)
- Vendor B (Luwelso Momirbel)
- Vendor C (Rinolso Nebre)
- Vendor D (Dravokne Fenpol)

Exactly one option is best overall. Which vendor should be selected? Your notes are incomplete: other participants hold information you do not have.

agents.shard_text:
Vendor A (Ozvoktal Ithbretal):
  - Vendor A provides on-site staff training
  - Vendor A completed a successful pilot at a peer hospital
  - Vendor A failed a recent security audit
  - Vendor A reported 1 major outages last year
  - Vendor A estimates deployment will take 3 months
Vendor B (Luwelso Momirbel):
  - Vendor B is financially stable
  - Vendor B performs encrypted off-site backups
  - Vendor B has a stable engineering team
  - Vendor B has poor references from similar hospitals
  - Vendor B provides no staff training
  - Vendor B currently serves 45 hospital clients
Vendor C (Rinolso Nebre):
  - Vendor C completed a successful pilot at a peer hospital
  - Vendor C passed an independent security audit
  - Vendor C does not meet accessibility standards
  - Vendor C offers straightforward contract exit terms
  - Vendor C reported 6 major outages last year
  - Vendor C currently serves 58 hospital clients
Vendor D (Dravokne Fenpol):
  - Vendor D has high engineering staff turnover
  - Vendor D offers support only during business hours
  - Vendor D imposes heavy penalties for contract exit
  - Vendor D performs encrypted off-site backups
  - Vendor D estimates deployment will take 15 months
